# kshell (Codex CLI entry)

This is the Codex entry point for the FUSION `kshell` skill. **It is a pointer, not the skill.** The full protocol, including every rule, failure mode and verified example, is in `SKILL.md` next to this file.

Codex does not inline markdown imports ([openai/codex#17401](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/17401)), so nothing below is a substitute for reading it. **Read `SKILL.md` with your file-read tool before acting on this skill**, and do not answer from this summary alone.

## When this skill applies

Drive KSHELL, the large-scale nuclear shell-model code of N. Shimizu, T. Mizusaki, Y. Utsuno and Y. Tsunoda (Comput. Phys. Commun. 244, 372 (2019); thick-restart block Lanczos; arXiv:1310.5431). Solve the M-scheme shell-model eigenvalue problem for a nucleus in a chosen valence space and interaction: ground-state and low-lying excitation energies, spins/parities, isospins, orbit occupations, quadrupole moments, and (via the transit executable) E2/M1 transition strengths. Ships 25 interactions spanning the sd shell (USDA/USDB), fp shell (GXPF1A, KB3G, FPD6), upper fp-g (JUN45), Sn region, and more. Use for 跑KSHELL, KSHELL input, shell model, 壳模型, configuration interaction, CI, large-scale diagonalization, Lanczos, USDA, USDB, GXPF1A, KB3G, sd shell, fp shell, energy levels, spin parity, spectroscopic, 20Ne, 24Mg, 48Cr, nuclear structure spectrum, valence space, effective interaction.
